data.body_html:
The Formula 1 Grand Prix 2033 weekend in Marbella is the most exhilarating event on the Costa del Sol calendar. With the circuit hugging the coastline, a Marbella yacht charter for the F1 Grand Prix 2033 weekend offers the ultimate vantage point: watch the race from the water, with the Mediterranean as your backdrop. Our fleet of 17 yachts departs from Puerto Banús, just minutes from the action. From the compact Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) to the spacious Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h), there's a boat for every group size and budget.

Why charter a yacht for the F1 Grand Prix?

Watching the race from a yacht combines luxury, privacy, and a front-row seat. You avoid the crowds, enjoy your own drinks and snacks, and can anchor at prime spots like Cabopino or near the circuit. Plus, you get a free jet ski with the Mangusta 80 (white or grey) – perfect for a pre-race spin.

Our fleet for the F1 weekend

All yachts depart from Puerto Banús. Here are the top picks for the Grand Prix:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h. Ideal for small groups.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – Same price tier. More space.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4h, includes free jet ski.
  • Mangusta 80 (Grey) (24m, 12 pax) – Same tier, different colour.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – Ultra-luxury, pricing on request.

For other boats (Azimut 58, Canados 86, etc.), contact us via WhatsApp for rates.

What’s included in every charter?

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs. You bring the appetite for the race.

Best viewing spots for the F1 Grand Prix

The circuit is visible from several points along the coast. Our skippers know the best anchorages. Popular spots include:

  • Cabopino Beach – calm waters, clear view of the track.
  • Near the circuit – close enough to hear the engines.
  • Marbella Marina – more sheltered, but still a great view.

We also provide a live feed on board so you don’t miss a lap.

How to book

Demand for the F1 weekend is sky-high. Book early – we recommend at least 3 months in advance. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing. For a full overview of our options, visit our Marbella yacht charter page.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best boat for the F1 Grand Prix weekend?

For a group of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 for 4 hours) offers space and a free jet ski. For smaller parties, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Can we watch the F1 race from the yacht?

Yes. Many guests anchor near Cabopino or along the coast with a clear view of the circuit. We also provide a live feed on board so you don’t miss a lap.

How do I book a yacht for the F1 weekend?

Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing. We recommend booking at least 3 months in advance as demand is very high.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%).

Can we bring our own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The yacht will have a cooler and ice on board.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellations made 14 days before the charter receive a full refund. Within 14 days, a 50% fee applies. No refunds within 48 hours.

Is there parking near Puerto Banús?

Yes, there are several paid parking lots within walking distance of the marina. We recommend arriving early as spaces fill quickly during F1 weekend.

Can we add extra hours or extend the charter?

Yes, subject to availability. Contact the skipper on the day to arrange an extension. Additional hours are charged at the pro-rata rate.
